packageMoves.scope: Depends only on OfficeIMO.Core. Markdown->HTML rendering stays in package (string renderer, no HTML engine).
packageMoves.reason: Conforms to the package rule; the in-package HTML renderer is a documented exception to adapter placement.

designResolutions.formatEnum: OfficeDocumentFormat; no OfficeFormat enum is introduced.
designResolutions.conversionDirection: Instance extensions on the source document; no static From factories.
designResolutions.asyncReports: OfficeConversionResult<T> carries the converted value and OfficeConversionReport.
designResolutions.frontDoorTarget: OfficeIMO, its batch engine, OfficeIMO.Workflows and OfficeIMO.Workflows.IWork target netstandard2.0, net8.0 and net10.0, plus net472 through the existing Windows-only project condition (approved c526a10ad2). Modern-only route engines are conditionally referenced and registered.
designResolutions.frameworks: Superseded by the approved c526a10ad2 design: retain netstandard2.0, net8.0, net10.0 and the original Windows-only net472 declaration; modern-only packages retain their original targets. Front door and Workflows gain the full set, with explicitly conditional modern engines.
designResolutions.modernAnalysis: Directory.Build.targets enables IsAotCompatible, EnableTrimAnalyzer and EnableAotAnalyzer for packable production library builds targeting net8.0/net10.0. Qualification remains in progress; older targets do not enable those analyzers.
designResolutions.syntaxNodes: TableCell, TableRow and ListItem retain their existing names because they are syntax-tree nodes; convenience models and builders retain the format-prefix changes.

phaseA.scope: Package boundaries, target frameworks, lifecycle, options, conversions and names.

extraChanges.note: ToHtml and SaveAsHtml return shared reports; raw-HTML stripping/filtering/escaping findings are emitted at their actual render sites. File output preserves the external-CSS sidecar owner.

extraChanges.subject: Read-only inspection and preservation types use Info
extraChanges.note: Phase A naming follows the approved rule that read-only snapshots end in Info. Geometry properties remain unchanged for Phase B.

extraChanges.subject: Completed conversion ownership and consumer grammar
extraChanges.note: Markdown.Pdf ToPdf completes private PDF rendering and returns the resulting model with writer-time diagnostics. Syntax-tree TableCell, TableRow and ListItem keep their names under the approved exception.

extraChanges.change: Dispose temporary PDF models after SaveAsPdf and failed ToPdf completion; successful ToPdf retains the authored model for subsequent composition.
extraChanges.reason: The unified IDisposable lifecycle transfers ownership only for returned models. Writer-time findings must complete before the public report is returned.
The approved format-prefix and read-only Info rules also apply to these public option, asset and page-scene types.

extraChanges.note: Async conversion entry points capture options before deferred work or resource awaits. The same snapshot supplies resource/size limits and final FailOnLoss acceptance; caller-owned template documents and callbacks retain their ownership.

Strict adapter PDF saves use the existing staged writer with shared report acceptance before publication. Source-stage and writer-time losses throw OfficeConversionException carrying OfficeConversionReport; native advanced result policies keep their existing behavior. The same writer and file/stream publication owners are reused. Front-door HTML/TXT saves dispose the generated model.

HTML conversion callers select MarkdownHtmlExportOptions.Kind explicitly where the removed ToHtmlDocument method selected Document. Fragment remains the default; WithCss callers use IncludeCssInFragment. Standalone Word Markdown tests assert literal raw HTML and html-block-as-text approximation; the front door verifies rich HTML paragraphs and inline formatting through its existing HTML owner.
Removed the reflection-only test requiring ToHtml to be absent. Word-to-Markdown text assertions use the native Markdown document writer and its final newline.
Canonical SaveAs output failures retain the completed conversion report through the shared internal output helper; cancellation continues to propagate unchanged.

Typed Markdown tables share declared property/field and dictionary projection with Core. They reject more than 10,000 data rows or 100 selected columns before adding a block. Runtime and explicit-selector paths retain the existing clipping counters. Formatter failures now propagate instead of silently falling back to unformatted values. Explicit alignment wins over heuristics; Markdown rejects justified columns. The NativeAOT smoke covers declared properties/fields, generic-only dictionary rows and empty dictionary schemas on net8.0 and net10.0.

extraChanges.change: 17 undocumented static helper types are internal after generated candidate review.
extraChanges.reason: These types implement rendering, parsing, package metadata or serialization behind the documented object model. Public models, syntax nodes, exceptions, attributes and virtual contracts remain visible.

extraChanges.change: Implementation access to internal helpers uses explicit friend assemblies.
extraChanges.reason: Callers were identified from actual C# identifier syntax in existing projects. Public third-party plug-in contracts remain public and receive no friend access.

extraChanges.change: Public API declarations and nullable annotations are enforced against shipped compiler baselines.
extraChanges.reason: The private Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.PublicApiAnalyzers build asset rejects unrecorded additions and removals without adding a runtime dependency. Existing framework-specific APIs retain separate shipped baselines where needed; target declarations and restore locks are unchanged.

extraChanges.change: Markdown NativeAOT smoke is qualified on net8.0 and net10.0.
extraChanges.reason: The existing smoke publishes for osx-arm64 with PublishAot enabled and its native executable creates, saves, reloads or renders the real document contract. Existing modern trimming and AOT analyzers remain enabled. Windows execution remains a separate qualification.

extraChanges.change: Maintained Windows and non-Windows package locks include the public API analyzer.
extraChanges.reason: Refreshes the existing release restore graphs for the private build dependency, preserving their runtime identifiers, framework sets and platform-selection mechanism.

applicationStatus: Phase A applied and validated on the supported macOS targets. Phase B and Tier 2 entries retain their status; Windows .NET Framework validation remains pending.
authority: Docs/officeimo.api-design.md, including the c526a10ad2 framework decision; the approved design overrides M0 open questions.

questionResolutions.conversionForms: Source.ToTarget, source.SaveAsTarget and OfficeConversionReport; async ToTarget returns OfficeConversionResult<T>. ToHtml returns string. No static From factories.
questionResolutions.frameworks: No framework is dropped in 3.6. Original library TFMs and Windows net472 conditions remain; the front door and both Workflows projects support the full set. Modern-only engines stay conditional.
questionResolutions.packageDirection: Word.Pdf and PowerPoint.Pdf export native documents. Reverse reconstruction is Pdf.Word and Pdf.PowerPoint; Excel reconstruction is Pdf.Excel. Word page images live in Word.Pdf.
questionResolutions.surface: Markdown syntax nodes are exempt from the format prefix. OfficeColor/OfficeColorRole use the root OfficeIMO namespace. Authoring, units, image-builder consolidation, visibility baselines and AOT smoke acceptance are Phase B.
